text_markup: The Runner has no credits in their credit pool and 1 credit hosted on {card:Fencer Fueno} when they make a successful run on a server with {card:Adrian Seis} rezzed in its root. When the ability on {card:Adrian Seis} resolves, the players play a Psi Game, which requires them both to bid 0, 1, or 2[c]. In this case, the Runner cannot bid 2[c], as they are not able to spend that number of credits. They can, however, bid 1[c], as they will be able to spend the credit from {card:Fencer Fueno} to pay for that bid.
